title: Sausage and Crumble Crumble
description: A savory crumble dish featuring sausage and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Cook the sausage in a pan until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Transfer the cooked sausage to a baking dish.
Mix the chopped walnuts and whole wheat breadcrumbs in a bowl.
Add the cold crumble topping to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the sausage.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown.
